maria.chen: Quick heads-up: weekly KPIs show webinar -> SAL conversion down ~28% vs 4wk baseline. Suspect attribution or traffic quality. Thoughts?
kevin.park: I see the dip in the dashboard. Which webinar id?
samir.patel: Also confirm attribution model. Last-touch 7d can miss multi-touch.
jen.liu: Form fills up but avg session duration is lower. Could be partner/syndication traffic.
olivia (mktg-ops): Exported HubSpot leads: ~50 leads missing utm_source for that webinar. Our form widget sometimes drops query params on redirect.
analytics-bot: Quick data snap:
SELECT attribution, COUNT(*) FROM leads WHERE webinar_id='2026_03_16' GROUP BY attribution; -- last_touch:243, first_touch:310, blank_utm:54
kevin.park: Blank utm aligns with the conversion gap. If those go to generic nurture, SAL rate falls.
maria.chen: Actions: 1) olivia add hidden webinar_id field + fix redirect (2 business days), 2) samir add multi-touch 30d toggle in weekly report (EOD Thu), 3) kevin run routing audit & CSV of blank_utm mappings (EOD Wed), 4) jen check partner referrer tags.
jen.liu: Temp mitigation: if fix >48h, route no-utm landing-page completions to SDR holding queue.
olivia (mktg-ops): Will PR redirect patch today; QA + deploy ~2 days.
samir.patel: I'll document methodology changes in the weekly metrics doc so execs know why numbers shift.
kevin.park: I'll drop a SQL report by EOD and post in #marketing.
analytics-bot: scheduled report weekly_leads_snapshot -> #marketing_reports Fri 08:00
maria.chen: Thanks everyone. Reconvene Fri 10am to review. :rocket:
